description: An assistant principal must approve the operating design for a six-week peer-tutoring pilot, including session structure, student safeguards, record handling, and implementation procedures, with input from a literacy coach and a student-services coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school is preparing a six-week peer-tutoring pilot for students who need additional reading practice.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Brooks has final approval authority for the pilot's operating design.
shared_context.S3: The draft proposal schedules 30-minute sessions with one peer tutor supporting up to four students.
shared_context.S4: The school normally holds a design review in which the program lead and relevant student-services staff give their sign-off before a new student program begins.

PF1.text: Mr. Shah's classroom observation memo shows that the pilot works only when each tutor supports no more than two students and each session lasts 20 minutes; he completed the memo yesterday, but the curriculum office's draft was locked before it was uploaded.

PF2.text: Ms. Nolan's compliance review requires signed guardian consent before participation, tutoring in visible rooms staffed by an adult, and deletion of identifiable tutoring records after exactly 90 days; her final consent protocol is in her case-management notes, while the design packet still uses the school's default program language.

acceptance_conditions: Each peer tutor must support no more than two students.
Each tutoring session must last exactly 20 minutes.
Signed guardian consent must be required before participation.
Tutoring must occur in a visible room staffed by an adult.
Identifiable tutoring records must be retained for exactly 90 days.

content_checks.C4: decisions['room_condition'] == 'visible rooms staffed by an adult'

decisive_facts.why: The observation memo changes the draft ratio from four students per tutor to exactly two and changes the session length from 30 minutes to exactly 20.

The compliance review changes participation to signed-guardian-consent-only, changes the room condition to visible rooms staffed by an adult, changes retention to exactly 90 days, and requires the decision-maker to cite PF2 after it is spoken aloud.
